sections.name: goal
sections.value: Give pij-spawned Copilot Claude seats a 1-hour prompt cache through the `pij-rs cache-proxy` sidecar (PRD 004, blueprint 003), proven on live seats against every row of the acceptance matrix (governance handover/cache-proxy-test-matrix.md).

value.title: Spike: token, quota gate, bounce retry, 1-hour cache
value.done_when: REPORT.md answers PRD q-01 and gives the evidence for q-02, the quota gate and row 2.
value.note: takin (model-cost), branch spike/004-cache-proxy 9a397862, spikes/REPORT.md; no PR. Fed PRD q-01, decision d-3 and d-4, and the prime's ruling 5 (sidecar).

value.title: The sidecar: crates/cache-proxy and `pij-rs cache-proxy`
value.done_when: With a hand-set `COPILOT_PROVIDER_*` on a plain `copilot` process: matrix rows 2, 9, 10, 11, 14, 15, 16, 17, 22 and 23 pass, `/__pij/status` matches blueprint c-status-route exactly, the spawn-sites test covers the `gh` launch, and no token appears in logs, argv or the config file.
value.note: Starts from the spike POC on spike/004-cache-proxy. Merges before s03. Delivered by #239.

value.title: Daemon side: spawn gate, receipt, notices, directory and doctor
value.done_when: Against a stub status route in tests, and the s02 sidecar once merged: matrix rows 1, 3 to 8, 12, 13 and 18 to 21 pass, with the cost rows k-4 and k-5 measured with `pij-rs --json ping` before and after.
value.note: Builds in parallel with s02 against the status route contract in blueprint c-status-route; rebases on s02 and merges after it.

value.title: Live-seat acceptance: all 23 matrix rows
value.done_when: Every row of handover/cache-proxy-test-matrix.md has a receipt from real pij seats (command, observed value, seat ids) in this workstream's proof, before the prime merges the last lane's state flip.
value.note: "Run by model-cost (takin) with pm-004. Receipts: docs/plans/004-acceptance/receipts.md (22 of 23 rows pass or are lane-proven). Row 12 FAILs (F205: an in-flight 402 after switching back latches quota_exhausted); its re-run follows s05 (plan 230), and s04 completes then."

value.title: Cache proxy watch: no false outage, stale upstream answers, seat-count notices
value.done_when: Plan 230 (docs/plans/230-cache-proxy-watch): a status read never waits on upstream and starts at most one background check; one slow watch read gives no notice, two in a row or a refusal give one; a gate read that times out is retried once; a 402 or 2xx answering a replaced token changes no state; notices give a seat count, never ids. Each guard has a test that fails without it, and the slow-upstream case is shown live on a private daemon and a test-port sidecar.
value.note: F204 (pm-001 LOG 2026-11-18: one slow probe made a false outage notice naming 43 seats), the stale 402 (takin's s04 row 12 finding: a 402 sent before an account switch latched the new account) and F205 (prime far-jackal: notices listed every proxied seat). Matrix row 12 is re-run in s04 after merge.

value.change: First draft: spike complete, two parallel build lanes (plans 228 and 229), then live-seat acceptance.
req-13 (`-1m` mapping, model id and max prompt tokens): the proxy side goes to s02, the spawn env to s03.
req-14 (subagent requests keep the 5-minute cache) goes to s02. It lands in #239's round-2 push, after the first verdicts.
#238 review N238-001: s02 done_when adds rows 22 and 23; s04 covers all 23 rows.

s02 complete, delivered by #239 (step notes carry the PR; steps have no delivered_by). req-01 added to s03's delivers and kept under s02: its done_when needs a pij-spawned seat, so it ships with s03's gate. s03 complete.
s04 in progress: 22 of 23 matrix rows receipted on the prod daemon and pij seats (rows 9-11 lane-proven via s02); row 12 FAIL (F205), to be re-run after s05 (plan 230).

s05 added and complete (plan 230): F204, F205 (notices give a seat count) and the stale-402 twin of F001 (s04's row 12 failure); delivers req-02 and req-09, builds c-readiness, c-status-route, c-spawn-gate, c-proxy-watch and c-doctor-row. Requirement states unchanged (both shipped); row 12 is re-run in s04.
